name: cityconnect-frontend
description: Workspace root. Two applications share one dependency tree and one UI kit: the staff console (web) and the citizen portal (web-portal). They are separate builds served from separate origins, so a resident never downloads admin code and the two never share a cookie jar.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace web-portal
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace web && npm run lint --workspace web-portal
